verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a dedicated Memory Export feature that produces structured exports using customizable Pydantic schemas, plus self-hosting with full data/stack ownership, both directly supporting portability and avoiding lock-in. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of export usage, details on export format completeness (e.g. full schema/relationship fidelity) and any documented import/round-trip path back into Mem0 or another store.
